cells: in_mask = 1 (analog search zone), ascending H3 index; ids as two u4 blocks (high, low 32 bits)
encoding: gzip; blocks: h3 high u4, h3 low u4, then one block per column; value = stored*scale + offset; stored = max of dtype means no data

columns.name: slope_deg
columns.label: Slope (median; ~460 m pixels, central differences ≈ 0.9 km baseline)

columns.name: roughness_deg
columns.label: Roughness (RMS slope after removing a plane)

columns.name: t_mean_K
columns.label: Mean surface temperature ((day + night) / 2, 12 monthly means)

columns.name: dust_aod
columns.label: Dust optical depth (visible, 550 nm, annual mean)

columns.name: ice_depth_m
columns.label: Depth to ground ice (class like Mars SWIM; 10 = no ice found)

columns.name: sun_elev_max_deg
columns.label: Highest noon Sun elevation over a year

columns.name: env
columns.label: 0 outside · 1 polar ice · 2 desert (bare) · 3 arid open

slope_deg.label: Slope
slope_deg.criterion: Operational: ~3° separates the slope classes for a rover (0–3 flat, 3–8 gentle, 8–15 moderate, > 15 steep; Curiosity's operational limit ~20°) and is ~2× the slope error between ~460 m DEMs

roughness_deg.label: Roughness (RMS slope)
roughness_deg.criterion: Measurement: ~2° is the noise of the RMS roughness with ~460 m DEMs (MOLA with < 50 % laser coverage, ETOPO); smaller differences are not significant

sun_elev_max_deg.label: Maximum Sun elevation
sun_elev_max_deg.criterion: Physical: a 10° difference in the highest Sun elevation changes the noon irradiance on a horizontal panel by ≲ 15 % (at mid elevations) and shadow length ~2× with a low Sun. With 3° the search was tied to the same latitude

t_mean_K.label: Mean annual temperature
t_mean_K.criterion: Climatic: ~15 K is the mean annual temperature difference between neighbouring climate belts on Earth (polar ↔ subpolar ↔ temperate). No Earth cell reaches the ~210 K of Mars: the soft curve still ranks them (the Antarctic plateau ahead of the Sahara)

t_max_K.label: Maximum annual temperature
t_max_K.criterion: Climatic: extremes vary more than the mean; 20 K ≈ the spread between the warmest month of two deserts at neighbouring latitudes. Also, Mars gives a P95 and Earth a monthly mean (a few K of bias)

t_min_K.label: Minimum annual temperature
t_min_K.criterion: Climatic: same as the maximum (20 K between neighbouring belts in the coldest month)

t_night_K.label: Night temperature (annual mean)
t_night_K.criterion: Climatic: like the annual mean (15 K between neighbouring belts)

precip_mm_year.label: Mean annual rainfall (aridity)
precip_mm_year.criterion: Aridity classes (UNEP): hyper-arid < 25 mm, arid 25–200, semi-arid 200–500. With a target of 0 (Mars, Moon), 100 mm/year = half the arid range → note 0.5

ice_depth_m.label: Ice depth
ice_depth_m.criterion: Operational, by instrument reach: ≤ 1 m is seen by neutrons/radar and reached by a short drill; 1–5 m needs a deep drill; > 5 m and 'no ice' are almost equivalent for surface operations

dust_aod.label: Airborne dust (optical depth)
dust_aod.criterion: Atmospheric: the Mars background is τ ≈ 0.3–0.6 (storms > 1) and Earth deserts τ ≈ 0.1–0.5; 0.15 ≈ the difference between a clean and a dusty desert

ruedas.label: Wheels / mobility
ruedas.test_validity: Wheel load scales with m·g: test with a lightened vehicle (g_target / g_Earth)

navegacion.label: Autonomous navigation / cameras
navegacion.test_validity: On Earth shadows move ~30 times faster and the sky fills them with diffuse light

perforacion.label: Drilling / sampling
perforacion.test_validity: The material can be reproduced; the subsurface temperature cannot

hielo.label: Ice detection
hielo.test_validity: Lunar ice sits in vacuum; Earth ice under an atmosphere: sublimation is different

energia_termica.label: Solar power and thermal control
energia_termica.test_validity: Earth never drops below ≈ −90 °C nor reaches the lunar noon (≈ +120 °C)

polvo.label: Dust, seals and mechanisms (Mars)
polvo.test_validity: Martian air is ~60 times thinner: dust is lifted differently

habitat.label: Habitat / human operations
habitat.test_validity: Neither reduced gravity nor radiation are reproduced

comunicaciones.label: Communications (line of sight)
comunicaciones.test_validity: The geometry of the relief is reproduced

labels.caves: Caves or lava tubes (0 = no, 1 = yes)
